source.what_this_is: A PLAN-ONLY descriptor of the Aug-3 R1 task, used to cost the two-arm experiment before the real fixture exists. It carries counts and task identity ONLY: no split, no bytes, no hashes of individual pairs. run_two_arm refuses to execute it.
source.observed_task_facts: 21 image/caption pairs, all 1024x768 PNG, krea2, ds design_aetherflow_ui, trigger phrase 'AetherFlow UI' present verbatim in 21/21 captions, 0.75 h grant (task-meta.json).
source.split_arithmetic: 18 train / 3 holdout = the validator's public ceil(total * 0.10) holdout rule applied to 21 pairs. INFERRED counts only; WHICH pairs land in the holdout is the fixture builder's decision and is not made here.
source.superseded_by: ops/experiments/week6/build_fixtures.py has since produced the real fixture for this task (12 train / 9 holdout at seed 20260806); run_two_arm consumes that manifest directly. This file survives only to cost a task before its fixture exists, and as the negative test that execution refuses a plan-only descriptor.
source.not_evidence: This file is a planning stand-in. It is not a fixture, it does not authorize training on harvested tournament images, and no score may cite it.
